title: Quiet tabletop
purpose: A product study with a simple surface and controlled light.
promptTemplate: Photograph {product} on a matte tabletop. Keep its proportions and markings. Use broad side light, a soft grounded shadow and an uncluttered background.
variants: Use a pale stone surface and cool morning light.
Use a warm paper surface and late afternoon light.
Use a dark surface with gentle edge lighting.

title: Window-light portrait
purpose: A natural portrait with a calm background.
promptTemplate: Create an expressive portrait of {person}. Place the subject near a large window with soft directional light, natural detail and a quiet background.
variants: Frame from the shoulders with a relaxed expression.
Frame from the waist with an informal pose.
Use a close crop with the eyes in sharp focus.

title: An everyday moment
purpose: Place a subject in a believable lived-in setting.
promptTemplate: Show {subject} in a believable everyday setting. Build a thoughtful composition with natural light, practical details and space around the main subject.
variants: Set the scene in a small sunlit kitchen.
Set the scene beside a shaded garden table.
Set the scene in a tidy workshop.

title: Editorial poster
purpose: A strong composition with room for your headline.
promptTemplate: Design an editorial poster around a single striking visual idea. Use a deliberate visual hierarchy and generous empty space for a headline added later. Do not invent brand marks or long text.
variants: Use a large central geometric form.
Use an asymmetrical still life.
Use a restrained collage of simple shapes.

title: One clear idea
purpose: A thumbnail that stays readable at a small size.
promptTemplate: Make a thumbnail about {subject}. Use one recognizable focal point, clear separation from the background and a strong silhouette. Leave space for short text added later.
variants: Place the focal point on the left.
Place the focal point on the right.
Use a centered close view.

title: The opening frame
purpose: A composed first image for a later video shot.
promptTemplate: Compose the opening frame of a video featuring {scene}. Establish the place clearly, keep the subject away from the edges and leave room for a slow camera move.
variants: Use early morning light.
Use a soft overcast atmosphere.
Use warm light just before sunset.

title: A visual language
purpose: Follow the lighting and material character of a reference.
promptTemplate: Create a new composition of {subject}, guided by the lighting, materials and visual rhythm of {style}. Keep a new composition; do not reproduce text, logos or an existing artwork.
variants: Use a clean, spacious composition.
Use a closer, more tactile composition.
Use a wider composition with layered depth.

title: Character anchor
purpose: A fictional character reference designed for reuse.
promptTemplate: Design an original fictional character in a neutral standing pose against a simple background. Show the face, outfit and distinguishing details clearly, with even light and a coherent silhouette.
variants: A friendly field researcher with practical clothing.
A thoughtful craftsperson with a work apron.
An energetic urban courier with a light jacket.

title: Softbox product portrait
purpose: A clean campaign image with precise materials.
promptTemplate: Create a refined image of {Subject}. Use {Background} and {Lighting}. Preserve reference identity, accurate materials and natural proportions.
variants: Keep the prepared direction.
Use a subtle variation while keeping the subject consistent.

title: Editorial colour story
purpose: A bold, colour-led image for your feed.
promptTemplate: Use the supplied references for this image treatment. Subject: {Subject}; Palette: {Palette}; Style: {Style}. Preserve identity, visual consistency and the original creative intent. Produce a polished, coherent result.
variants: Keep the prepared direction.
Use a subtle variation while keeping the subject consistent.

title: Quiet architecture
purpose: Turn a place into a considered visual story.
promptTemplate: Use the supplied references for this image treatment. Subject: {Subject}; Time: {Time}; Style: {Style}. Preserve identity, visual consistency and the original creative intent. Produce a polished, coherent result.
variants: Keep the prepared direction.
Use a subtle variation while keeping the subject consistent.

title: A measured reveal
purpose: Introduce a product with one deliberate camera move.
promptTemplate: Reveal {opening} in one continuous shot. Begin with the subject partially framed, then move gently to a clear full view. Keep the product geometry and markings stable.
variants: A slow lateral slide.
A gentle rising move.
A subtle forward move.

title: Closer, slowly
purpose: Let a scene unfold through a restrained push-in.
promptTemplate: Make a single shot based on {opening}. Move the camera slowly forward while keeping the main subject stable and the background movement natural.
variants: Keep the move low and level.
Move at eye height.
Approach from slightly above.

title: Around the subject
purpose: See a subject from a gently changing viewpoint.
promptTemplate: Make a restrained partial orbit around {opening}. Keep the subject coherent while the background reveals depth. Avoid a full spin or sudden camera acceleration.
variants: Orbit a little to the left.
Orbit a little to the right.
Combine a short orbit with a slight push-in.

title: A walking conversation
purpose: A steady moving shot with a fictional presenter.
promptTemplate: Show {reference} walking at a comfortable pace while speaking naturally. Use a steady tracking shot, believable gestures and an environment with clear depth. The subject is fictional unless an authorized reference is supplied.
variants: Track from the front.
Track from a three-quarter view.
Track beside the subject.

title: Between two moments
purpose: Connect an opening and closing composition.
promptTemplate: Create a coherent transition from {opening} to {closing}. Preserve a believable sense of space and let the visual change develop smoothly rather than as an abrupt cut.
variants: Use a calm, even pace.
Hold briefly at the start before moving.
Slow the movement near the closing frame.

title: A small repeating motion
purpose: Build a quiet clip with a repeatable rhythm.
promptTemplate: Make a calm ambient shot of {opening}. Keep the camera fixed and use a small, repeatable movement that can return close to its starting state. Do not promise a perfectly seamless loop.
variants: A gentle movement of leaves.
A slow change in reflected light.
A subtle drift of steam.

title: A sense of place
purpose: Establish the setting before the story begins.
promptTemplate: Create a wide establishing shot of an original location. Show clear foreground, middle distance and background, with a restrained camera move and a consistent atmosphere.
variants: A quiet coastal workshop at dawn.
A neighborhood market before opening.
A hillside observatory in soft evening light.

title: Let the photo breathe
purpose: Animate a photo without changing its main composition.
promptTemplate: Animate {opening} with subtle environmental motion. Keep the main composition and subject identity stable. Avoid sudden movement, added people or invented lettering.
variants: A light breeze with almost no camera move.
A subtle forward drift.
A gentle shift of light and shadow.

title: The slow reveal
purpose: A measured reveal that makes a product feel special.
promptTemplate: Use the supplied references for this video treatment. Subject: {Subject}; Movement: {Movement}; Lighting: {Lighting}. Preserve identity, visual consistency and the original creative intent. Produce a polished, coherent result.
variants: Keep the prepared direction.
Use a subtle variation while keeping the subject consistent.

title: Golden-hour walk
purpose: A relaxed lifestyle shot with gentle camera movement.
promptTemplate: Create a continuous video shot of {Subject} in {Setting}. Use {Movement}, subtle natural movement, consistent identity and believable lighting.
variants: Keep the prepared direction.
Use a subtle variation while keeping the subject consistent.

title: After hours
purpose: A moody city sequence with controlled movement.
promptTemplate: Use the supplied references for this video treatment. Setting: {Setting}; Movement: {Movement}; Lighting: {Lighting}. Preserve identity, visual consistency and the original creative intent. Produce a polished, coherent result.
variants: Keep the prepared direction.
Use a subtle variation while keeping the subject consistent.
